description: Tool adapters. Each entry: detect (the --detect command), install_hint (what to run if missing), invoke (usage). Adapters are thin wrappers around a CLI the user installs SEPARATELY — zero license entanglement. Added per-tool as each capability bundle lands.

screenshot.install_hint: npm i -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium   (or: brew install playwright && playwright install chromium)
screenshot.engine: playwright (browser) + python3 (ephemeral static server for local files)
